name: issue-triage-action
description: GitHub Action that triages new issues with an LLM: type, labels, priority, duplicates and missing details.
author: Miraç Deprem

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --legal-comments=none --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.all: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
